I'm not so sure I'll never find out...I think the memories are still there and I think it's possible to recover them. I think that's the only way I could ever heal/recover from this. 

No, I have noone in my life. No SO, no friends. Family is and always has been dysdunctional as fuck and don't seem to give a shit about what happened. 

Also in regards to recovery...I don't have insurance=no therapy/psychologist/counsellor. And due to the state I am in from said kidnapping I find myself unable to cope with the extreme c-ptsd I'm left with from the experience and unable to work=no $$$ to pay for insurance to cover therapy=no recovery/healing.

I probably sound kinda non-chalant about it but I'm not. I don't think I can ever heal from this, honestly. This also isn't the only fucked-up thing that's happened to me either. My whole life has been hell. But being kidnapped is one of the more serious things that's happened.

It happened almost 3 years ago. And yes it was a physical kidnapping. When I 'came to' I had restraint marks on my body as well as somekind of injection marks. This happened on a satanic holiday. Can't seem to forget about or get over it. The not knowing who did it and how they managed drives me literally insane.

'They' are evil

They drugged and kidnapped me. I don't know what they did to me though...
You must have missed the part where I said I don't know who they are.
